title: Restore local sign-in database access
summary: Corrected the earlier local backend restart: its restricted network environment prevented session database access and caused login HTTP 503 responses.

changes.detail: Replaced the sandbox-restricted local backend with a backend running with access to the existing configured database, bound to 127.0.0.1:3002. Application source and credentials were unchanged; affected runtime files are listed for traceability.
Appended this correction to the previous verification report: unauthenticated GET 401 did not verify database connectivity; login requires an actual database-backed check.

validation.detail: node scripts/check-learning-owner.mjs passed outside the network sandbox. The restricted environment had failed with EACCES.
validation.name: Backend configuration and database

validation.detail: POST empty JSON returned 400 INVALID_INPUT after the database-backed throttle checks. One synthetic invalid login returned 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS with the correct localhost:8081 CORS header, replacing the observed HTTP 503.
validation.name: Database-backed login endpoint

validation.detail: User must retry with their existing password; no real password was accessed, changed or submitted. No deployment or source code changes.
validation.name: Actual owner login
